title: Borgata Hotel Casino & Spa — Overview and history
body: Signature edition. Original Signature organizational framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Signature profile of Borgata Hotel Casino & Spa: Borgata Hotel Casino & Spa is a luxury hotel and casino in Atlantic City's Marina District, opened on July 2, 2003. Now operated by MGM Resorts International, it holds about 2,767 rooms across the Borgata and Water Club towers and is known for its poker room, the Event Center, and high-end dining. It is consistently among the top-grossing casinos in Atlantic City.
